define.path.description: Absolute value identity beginning with `/`, at most 127 UTF-8 bytes. Define rejects duplicates; bind requires an existing path. Paths identify retained application values, not files.
define.path.section: Define, bind and edit a value

define.type.default: Inferred from value; number when omitted
define.type.description: `number`, `boolean`, `string` or `json`. Fixed until removal/redefinition; explicit JSON preserves any valid JSON root.
define.type.section: Define, bind and edit a value

define.value.default: 0 for number; required for other kinds
define.value.description: Initial owned value. Finite unbound number within ±1e12; boolean/string/JSON must match their declared kind and storage budgets. Bound values must also satisfy the target contract.
define.value.section: Define, bind and edit a value

define.readonly.description: Boolean flag preventing subsequent set operations. Owner-controlled rebinding and explicit removal remain available.
define.readonly.section: Define, bind and edit a value

define.binding.description: Binding descriptor object; initializes the target immediately. Omit this member for an unbound definition. Null detachment belongs to bind. Invalid target existence, kind or domain rejects the whole definition.
define.binding.section: Define, bind and edit a value

define.binding.family.description: Native target family, with family-specific fields and value types. Choose from material, emitter, widget, camera, window, text, area, floor, state, node, indicator, prompt, environment, field, flow, surface, surface-wave, float-body, surface-foam, mesh, triangle, cell-art, accessibility or electrical-arc.
define.binding.family.section: Define, bind and edit a value

define.binding.id.description: Target identity; family-dependent domain. Most identified resources require 1..65535, field supports 1..4294967295, and singleton families use 0. Material uses its slot domain. Camera ignores the optional ID. Omission cannot create a missing identified resource.
define.binding.id.section: Define, bind and edit a value

define.binding.field.description: Exact family-specific property name, at most 31 UTF-8 bytes. Nested property names such as position.x and channels.r are literal addresses. Unknown fields or incompatible numeric/boolean/string/JSON targets reject; consult the binding references below.
define.binding.field.section: Define, bind and edit a value

bind.path.description: Absolute value identity beginning with `/`, at most 127 UTF-8 bytes. Define rejects duplicates; bind requires an existing path. Paths identify retained application values, not files.
bind.path.section: Define, bind and edit a value

bind.binding.description: Replacement descriptor object or explicit null to detach. Replacement immediately applies the retained value to the new target; incompatible values reject atomically. Old target property is preserved.
bind.binding.section: Define, bind and edit a value

bind.binding.family.description: Native target family, with family-specific fields and value types. Choose from material, emitter, widget, camera, window, text, area, floor, state, node, indicator, prompt, environment, field, flow, surface, surface-wave, float-body, surface-foam, mesh, triangle, cell-art, accessibility or electrical-arc.

bind.binding.id.description: Target identity; family-dependent domain. Most identified resources require 1..65535, field supports 1..4294967295, and singleton families use 0. Material uses its slot domain. Camera ignores the optional ID. Omission cannot create a missing identified resource.
bind.binding.id.section: Define, bind and edit a value

bind.binding.field.description: Exact family-specific property name, at most 31 UTF-8 bytes. Nested property names such as position.x and channels.r are literal addresses. Unknown fields or incompatible numeric/boolean/string/JSON targets reject; consult the binding references below.

remove-value.path.description: Absolute identity beginning with `/`, at most 127 UTF-8 bytes. Existing trigger, style-rule or scheduled consumers prevent removal. An absent valid path is a no-op. Successful removal preserves the target component's last authored property.

schedule.id.description: Integer 1..65535; unique among pending commands. Reusing a pending identity rejects.

schedule.atUs.description: Absolute integer scene microseconds, 0..86400000000, at or after the current clock. Past times and fractions reject. Execution belongs to clock advancement; rendering does not fire it.

schedule.command.description: Owned native command object or allowed batch, at most 4095 UTF-8 bytes. Invalid current-state dependencies and operations excluded from scheduling reject; see the transaction reference for the allowed-operation contract.

cancel-schedule.id.description: Identity of an existing pending command. Missing identities reject; cancellation neither executes the command nor reverses earlier work.

floor.enabled.description: Boolean; enables the floor receiver for eligible particle collisions.

floor.visible.description: Boolean; draws the floor guide independently of whether collisions are enabled.

floor.height.description: −1000..1000 world units; horizontal collision plane and guide height.

floor.restitution.description: 0..1; scales the outgoing vertical speed on bounce.

floor.settleSpeed.description: 0..30; participates in the effect-dependent collision settling condition. It is not a universal hard speed cutoff.

floor.reentrainWindSpeed.description: 0..256; tangential wind magnitude above which an eligible individual deposit can return to live motion; zero disables this re-entrainment path.

floor.maxIndividual.description: Integer 0..512; individual-deposit limit for the floor receiver, subject to the shared scene pool.

floor.maxTiles.description: Integer 0..256; aggregate-tile limit for the floor receiver, subject to the shared scene pool.

floor.overflow.description: `reject-new` or `merge-to-field`; selects rejection or compatible aggregation when individual deposits cannot be allocated.

floor.retentionMs.description: 0..86400000 milliseconds; zero disables timed expiry, otherwise deposits/tiles expire at their retained age limit.

floor.fadeMs.description: 0..60000 milliseconds; fade interval at the end of a nonzero retention period. Must fit within that period.

floor.evaporation.description: 0..10; wetness reduction per simulation second, clamped at zero. This is distinct from deposit expiry.

floor.cellSize.description: 0.1..100 world units; X/Z bucket size for floor aggregates and their drawn footprint.

floor.alpha.description: 0..1; opacity of the visible floor guide. Individual and aggregate deposits have their own opacity calculation.

floor.sampling.description: `cell`, `half`, `braille` or `hybrid`; floor presentation policy, including its aggregate drawing.

environment.background.description: Integer 0..16777215, packed 24-bit RGB. It supplies the solid color or base tint of the procedural palette.

environment.stars.description: Integer 0..2000; controls seeded star density. Zero disables star drawing. This is not a promise of that exact number of visible stars.

environment.starFar.description: 20..1000 world units; star distance limit around the camera, with distance-dependent exposure/fade.

environment.sampling.description: `cell`, `half`, `braille` or `hybrid`; shared environment sampling policy. Component-specific sampling remains separate.

environment.style.description: `solid`, `linear`, `plasma`, `wave`, `caustic` or `contours`; selects the screen-space background formula.

environment.occlusionTint.description: 0..1; how strongly braille particles hidden behind the front particle in a cell tint that cell's background. 1 is the full tint, 0 shows only the scene behind them.

environment.occludedDots.description: `hidden` or `merge`; `hidden` keeps particles behind the front one out of the cell's dots, `merge` adds their dots to it.

surface.thermalEvaporation.description: 0–10; extra wetness loss per heat unit

widget.id.description: Required identified resource; reserve it in the application

widget.kind.description: One of the families above; a fresh widget defaults to text

widget.border.description: none, rounded, square, double, heavy; default none

widget.enabled.description: Boolean flags; defaults true, false, false

widget.selected.description: Boolean flags; defaults true, false, false

widget.active.description: Boolean flags; defaults true, false, false

widget.text.description: Retained Unicode text within native text capacity; initially empty

widget.value.description: Finite −1,000,000–1,000,000; defaults 0, 0, 1; max must exceed min

widget.min.description: Finite −1,000,000–1,000,000; defaults 0, 0, 1; max must exceed min

widget.max.description: Finite −1,000,000–1,000,000; defaults 0, 0, 1; max must exceed min

widget.data.description: Up to 128 finite values, each −1,000,000–1,000,000; initially empty

widget.mode.description: Integer 0–15; default 0; interpretation belongs to the kind

widget.sampling.description: inherit, cell, half, braille, hybrid; default inherit; geometric widgets only

widget.revealMs.description: Duration through 60000 ms; default 0; geometric widgets only

widget.replay.description: Boolean command option; true restarts reveal at current scene time

status.durationMs.description: Fixed dwell; default 6000 ms; zero prevents automatic expiry

status.mode.description: static, horizontal, vertical, fade, pop, horizontal-fade, vertical-fade; default static

status.priority.description: Integer 0–100; chooses next queued record, not preemption

status.startTimeUs.description: Exact integer native timestamp, 0–86400000000; defaults to current time

status.key.description: Optional grouping key, at most 63 UTF-8 bytes, scoped to area

status.coalesce.description: none, count, replace-queued; default none; merging requires a nonempty key

status.important.description: Default false; important history requires explicit acknowledgment

status.actions.description: At most four uniquely identified action records

status.minDurationMs.description: Derived-dwell bounds; defaults 1000 and 60000 ms; each 0–86400000 ms

status.maxDurationMs.description: Derived-dwell bounds; defaults 1000 and 60000 ms; each 0–86400000 ms

text.text.description: Retained Unicode source within native text capacity

text.effect.description: Exact text-family catalogue identity; unknown/wrong-family names reject

text.easing.description: linear, ease-in, ease-out, smooth, smoother, sine, step, cubic, back, bounce

material.space.description: One of the eight spaces above

material.channels.description: Space-specific scalar values or track objects

material.blend.description: One of the named modes below

material.gradient.description: At most 16 stops, exactly three numbers per stop

material.index.description: Scalar/track in −10000–10000, used for gradient sampling

material.alpha.initial.description: Target channel domain; base value at scene time zero before index offset and boundary/easing.

material.alpha.rate.description: −10000..10000 target units per period; not necessarily units per second.

material.alpha.min.description: Target channel domain, ordered bounds; equal bounds produce the minimum constant.

material.alpha.max.description: Target channel domain, ordered bounds; equal bounds produce the minimum constant.

material.alpha.step.description: −10000..10000 target units per sampled index; uniform material scope uses index zero.

material.alpha.periodMs.description: Positive, at most 3600000 milliseconds, exactly representable in whole microseconds; fresh tracks use 1000 ms.

material.alpha.boundary.description: clamp, loop, reverse, random or smooth-random; fresh alpha clamps, gradient index loops.

material.alpha.easing.description: linear, ease-in, ease-out, smooth, smoother, sine or step; fresh tracks use linear.

material.alpha.seed.description: Integer 0..4294967295; fresh tracks use 1; supplies deterministic random-boundary values.

material.index.initial.description: Target channel domain; base value at scene time zero before index offset and boundary/easing.

material.index.rate.description: −10000..10000 target units per period; not necessarily units per second.

material.index.min.description: Target channel domain, ordered bounds; equal bounds produce the minimum constant.

material.index.max.description: Target channel domain, ordered bounds; equal bounds produce the minimum constant.

material.index.step.description: −10000..10000 target units per sampled index; uniform material scope uses index zero.

material.index.periodMs.description: Positive, at most 3600000 milliseconds, exactly representable in whole microseconds; fresh tracks use 1000 ms.

material.index.boundary.description: clamp, loop, reverse, random or smooth-random; fresh alpha clamps, gradient index loops.

material.index.easing.description: linear, ease-in, ease-out, smooth, smoother, sine or step; fresh tracks use linear.

material.index.seed.description: Integer 0..4294967295; fresh tracks use 1; supplies deterministic random-boundary values.

window.shape.description: Rectangle, rounded, ellipse, hexagon, diamond, capsule, ticket, squircle, petal, wave, cloud or polygon

window.sourceGeometry.description: Boolean; opts into preserved source geometry

window.minColumns.description: Integers8..2147483647; ordered; minimum strictly greater than `2*(padding+1)`

window.maxColumns.description: Integers8..2147483647; ordered; minimum strictly greater than `2*(padding+1)`

window.fadeStartRatio.description: Start0.001..8, end0..8; end strictly below start

window.fadeEndRatio.description: Start0.001..8, end0..8; end strictly below start

node.label.description: Up to 256 Unicode scalars of retained label source.

node.detail.description: Up to 512 Unicode scalars of retained detail source.

node.kind.description: Up to 47 UTF-8 bytes; source classification, not a reserved callback name.

node.status.description: Up to 127 UTF-8 bytes of retained status source.

node.sha.description: Up to 128 UTF-8 bytes; display metadata, not automatic object-integrity verification.

node.position.description: XYZ world coordinates, each −16000..16000; explicit placement resets the target pose.

node.color.description: RGB24 integer 0..16777215; zero uses automatic kind-derived renderer color.

node.minColumns.description: Integer 8..2147483647; must fit border/padding and not exceed maxColumns.

node.shaPrefix.description: Integer 0..128; zero displays the full retained hash text, otherwise limits the displayed prefix.

node.showKind.description: Boolean presentation flags; hiding a field preserves its retained source.

node.showStatus.description: Boolean presentation flags; hiding a field preserves its retained source.

node.showSha.description: Boolean presentation flags; hiding a field preserves its retained source.

node.showDetail.description: Boolean presentation flags; hiding a field preserves its retained source.

indicator.id.description: Required integer 1–65535; updates the same identified slot

indicator.sequence.description: Nonempty, at most 128 Unicode scalars; JSON default `"/|\\-"`

indicator.stepMs.description: Positive duration, at most 60000 ms, whole-microsecond representation; default 120 ms

pause.paused.description: Boolean; `true` stops clock advancement, `false` permits it. At the raw native command boundary omission retains the existing value.

time.timeUs.default: Existing target at the raw boundary
time.timeUs.description: Integer microseconds, 0..86400000000, at least the current scene time. Supply an explicit target in application code.

time.budget.description: Integer 1..4096; maximum simulation steps for this command.

reset.seed.description: Integer 0..4294967295; replaces the seed used by scene defaults.

reset.preservePrompt.description: Boolean; copies the existing Prompt structure back after defaults initialize.

emitter.effect.description: A current native particle-effect catalogue identity

emitter.seed.default: Hash of scene seed XOR emitter ID
emitter.seed.description: uint32; explicit seeds reproduce the configured random sequence

emitter.count.description: Integer 0..100000 scheduled births; not a guarantee that this many particles fit concurrently

emitter.rate.description: 0..10000; a positive value selects rate-based emission; do not author together with `count`

emitter.startTimeUs.description: Microseconds, not before the current time, within the 24-hour scene range

emitter.cycles.description: Integer 1..10000; rate-based emission requires one cycle

emitter.extent.description: Each 0..2000; shape extent in the birth frame

emitter.birthOrientation.description: Each −3600..3600 degrees; active X, then Y, then Z rotations

emitter.initialOrientation.description: Each −3600..3600 degrees; authored motion supported for leaves/snow

emitter.angularVelocity.description: Each −720..720 degrees/second; authored motion supported for leaves/snow

emitter.topology.description: Integer 0..5; geometry treatment, with profile-specific defaults

emitter.wind.description: Each −256..256; air velocity in scene units/second

emitter.lifetimeMinMs.description: Minimum at least 1 ms; maximum 3600000 ms; ordered bounds

emitter.lifetimeMaxMs.description: Minimum at least 1 ms; maximum 3600000 ms; ordered bounds

emitter.endStyle.description: `drain`, `settle`, `dissolve`, `gust`, `quench`, `disperse`; the effect must support the selected ending

emitter.farFadeDistance.description: 0..10000; no greater than far minus near distance

emitter.colliders.description: Explicit object with `floor` Boolean and named surface ID array
